name: David McAllister - Après le § 34 - Am 19
title: REPORT on the implementation of the common foreign and security policy – annual report 2025
part_text: 34a. Notes that the United States has a long-standing history of foreign military intervention, which is incompatible with international law; recalls that the United States exerts pressure on EU Member States to join these illegal military interventions; condemns all use of force or threat of military intervention by the United States, including against Greenland, Canada, Panama and Venezuela, and the systematic weakening of the UN-based international order;
